#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <map>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <string>
#include <cctype>

using namespace std;

static long long binomial[61][61];
static int numA[61], numB[61];
static long long minDifference;
static string chars;
static map<string, long long> cache;
static int R, C;

long long nextLongValue() {
    long long value = 0;
    bool negative = false;
    int ch;
    bool inNumber = false;
    while ((ch = getchar()) != EOF) {
        if (ch == '-') {
            inNumber = true;
            negative = true;
            continue;
        } else if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
            inNumber = true;
            value = value * 10 + (ch - '0');
        } else if (inNumber) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return negative ? -value : value;
}

int nextIntValue() {
    int value = 0;
    bool negative = false;
    int ch;
    bool inNumber = false;
    while ((ch = getchar()) != EOF) {
        if (ch == '-') {
            inNumber = true;
            negative = true;
            continue;
        } else if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
            inNumber = true;
            value = value * 10 + (ch - '0');
        } else if (inNumber) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return negative ? -value : value;
}

string nextStringValue() {
    string buffer;
    int ch;
    bool inToken = false;
    while ((ch = getchar()) != EOF) {
        if (isalpha(ch) || isdigit(ch) || ch == '?') {
            inToken = true;
            buffer += (char)ch;
        } else if (inToken) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return buffer;
}

void traverse(long long leftSum, long long rightSum, int index1, int index2) {
    long long diff = llabs(leftSum - rightSum);
    if (minDifference <= 1 || diff - binomial[index1][R] * binomial[index2][R] >= minDifference) return;
    if (index1 == R - 1 && index2 == R - 1) {
        if (diff < minDifference) minDifference = diff;
        return;
    }
    if (index1 >= R) {
        long long delta = binomial[index1][R] - binomial[index1 - 1][R];
        long long multiplier = binomial[index2][R];
        traverse(leftSum, rightSum + delta * multiplier, index1 - 1, index2);
    }
    if (index2 >= R) {
        long long delta = binomial[index2][R] - binomial[index2 - 1][R];
        long long multiplier = binomial[index1][R];
        traverse(leftSum + delta * multiplier, rightSum, index1, index2 - 1);
    }
}

long long explore(long long leftSum, long long rightSum, int index1, int index2) {
    long long diff = llabs(leftSum - rightSum);
    if (diff - binomial[index1][R] * binomial[index2][R] > minDifference) return 0LL;
    string state = to_string(leftSum) + ":" + to_string(index1) + ":" + to_string(index2);
    if (cache.find(state) != cache.end()) return cache[state];
    if (index1 < R || index2 < R) {
        if (index1 >= numA[index1 + index2] && index2 >= numB[index1 + index2]) {
            int combined = index1 + index2;
            index1 -= numA[combined];
            index2 -= numB[combined];
            return binomial[index1 + index2][index1];
        }
        return 0LL;
    }
    long long result = 0LL;
    char token = chars[index1 + index2 - 1];
    if (token != 'B') {
        long long delta = binomial[index1][R] - binomial[index1 - 1][R];
        long long multiplier = binomial[index2][R];
        result += explore(leftSum, rightSum + delta * multiplier, index1 - 1, index2);
    }
    if (token != 'A') {
        long long delta = binomial[index2][R] - binomial[index2 - 1][R];
        long long multiplier = binomial[index1][R];
        result += explore(leftSum + delta * multiplier, rightSum, index1, index2 - 1);
    }
    cache[state] = result;
    return result;
}

int main() {
    R = nextIntValue();
    C = nextIntValue();
    for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * (R + C); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            if (j == 0 || j == i) binomial[i][j] = 1;
            else binomial[i][j] = binomial[i - 1][j - 1] + binomial[i - 1][j];
        }
    }
    long long left = 0, right = 0;
    int idx1 = R + C, idx2 = R + C;
    while (idx1 >= R && idx2 >= R) {
        if (left > right) {
            long long delta = binomial[idx1][R] - binomial[idx1 - 1][R];
            long long multiplier = binomial[idx2][R];
            right += delta * multiplier;
            idx1--;
        } else {
            long long delta = binomial[idx2][R] - binomial[idx2 - 1][R];
            long long multiplier = binomial[idx1][R];
            left += delta * multiplier;
            idx2--;
        }
    }
    minDifference = llabs(left - right);
    traverse(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
    chars = nextStringValue();
    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (R + C); i++) {
        numA[i + 1] = numA[i] + (chars[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
        numB[i + 1] = numB[i] + (chars[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
    }
    long long total = explore(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
    cout << total << endl;
    return 0;
}
